title: docs(adr): ADR-0138 dated note — D5 is built for the public form doors
body:
Refs #25574

Adds a dated note to ADR-0138 recording that D5 ("the public-site binding: shape only, built when demand arrives") is now built for the public form doors, by #25641, and the shape it took. Only `docs/adr/0138-guest-model-anonymous-principal-doors-grants-and-organization.md` changes; no changeset (`docs/adr/**` publishes nothing). #25574 stays open on this PR; the code PR #25641 carries its closing keyword.

## What the note says

- A status-block line, `· **Note** (2026-10-24, ruling B on #25447, 6377889413, maintainer 「#9 同意」; card #25574)`, pointing at the note under D5; every other decision of the record is unchanged.
- Under D5, the ruling quoted verbatim, the demand that triggered it (several legal entities, one organization each, on one hosted environment, each publishing the same package's registration form), and D5's four elements as built: the organization is `sharing.organizations` on the form, by slug, named by the link's `?organization=` parameter; a missing or unlisted organization is answered as an unpublished form, with no fallback to the default organization; the guest grants are unchanged (the form grant, now resolved under the bound organization; no set bound to `guest`); the allowed doors are the two public form doors only, and the class 4/5 endpoint doors keep D4's located refusal.
- The D5 heading's own words ("shape only, built when demand arrives") and the enforcement map's "the site binding | nothing" row are left as written; the note supersedes them for the form doors.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `4512b4bb8` derived 20 commands; all 20 run, each exit captured before any pipe, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciles "20 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 20 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)". The first run of `check-adr-symbol-anchors.mjs` exited 1 on a path anchor to `packages/core/src/security/public-form-organization.ts`, a file only #25641 adds; the note names that decision by its export instead. `check:doc-formula-expressions` first refused with a prerequisite (`@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` unbuilt in this fresh worktree); after building both it exited 0.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**
ADR-0138 加一条带日期的说明：D5（"公共站点绑定：只定形状，有需求时再建"）已经为公共表单建成，由 #25641 实现。说明记录了建成后的样子：表单上声明它发布到哪些组织（按组织 slug），链接带上组织（`?organization=`），提交落进链接点名的那个组织、用那个组织自己的编号。只改这一个 ADR 文件，不改代码。

**为什么改**
裁决 B（#25447 评论 6377889413，维护者「#9 同意」）要求实现 D5。代码在 #25641 里落地；ADR 原文仍写着"只定形状、什么都没声明"，不加这条说明，记录就和代码对不上，下一个读 ADR 的人会以为这个能力不存在。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**
只是文档，不影响运行时。风险在于时序：如果 #25641 没合或被回滚，这条说明就会描述一个不存在的能力，所以建议在 #25641 合并之后再合本 PR。回滚：直接 revert 本 PR 即可，不牵连其他文件。

**席位意见**


**你要做的**
在 #25641 合并后，审阅并批准合并本 PR。
